t: Subpart B, part 1 of the Appendix is amended by striking out “On or before 6/30/80” in the effective period column applicable to items 905.10 and 905.11 and inserting in lieu thereof “On or before 6/30/ 85”.

fable.w: This section is a technical amendment that extends the effective period for two tariff schedule items by replacing one date with another. No party outside the federal government is consulted, heard, or given a right to object or sue; no rulemaking, hearing, or advisory body is involved. There is no real tempting reading here, since nothing in the text touches on any outside-party process.
fable.s: striking out “On or before 6/30/80” in the effective period column applicable to items 905.10 and 905.11 and inserting in lieu thereof “On or before 6/30/ 85”

opus.w: This section only changes the effective-period date for items 905.10 and 905.11 in the Appendix, from 6/30/80 to 6/30/85. It does not set up any consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue. A federal legal change by itself is not participation unless the text brings in a party outside the federal government, and this text brings in no one.
opus.b: 1. The tempting reading is that this amends a federal legal schedule, so it might count as a federal decision. That fails because there is no process involving anyone outside the federal government: no consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue. The section only changes an effective-period date.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a technical amendment to an appendix, specifically updating an effective date for certain items. It does not mention any consultation, coordination, public hearing, comment period, or advisory committee involving parties outside the federal government. The action is purely internal and administrative.
qwen_chat.s: Subpart B, part 1 of the Appendix is amended by striking out “On or before 6/30/80” in the effective period column applicable to items 905.10 and 905.11 and inserting in lieu thereof “On or before 6/30/ 85”.

It is a purely internal administrative update.
